name: population persons
description: number of inhabitants for the drinking water supply area

name: average consumption (lppd)
description: average drinking water consumption in liter per person per day

name: leakage factor
description: leakage factor as a fraction, i.e. a value of 0.1 corresponds to 10%

name: large-scale consumption
description: large-scale consumption from industry, agiculture, etc. in cubic metres a day

name: number of lanes
description: number of parallel lanes in a treatment plant

name: peak demand factor
description: Factor of peak water demand, i.e. the nominal flow multiplied by the peak factor demand is the expected peak flow. Most times, this is about 1.4 (140%).

name: PLC costs
description: Costs for PLC hardware and software

name: emission factor (electricity)
description: plant-wide emission factor for electricity consumption

name: operation and maintenance rate
description: operation and maintenance rate, i.e. a percentage rate which is multiplied with the total investment costs to get the operational expenditure (OPEX).
